turbine.en: Enough wind turbines and solar panels could deliver all the energy a country needed.
turbine.zh: 只要有足够的风力发电机和太阳能电池板，就能提供一个国家所需的所有能源。

turkey.en: Traditionally, this is eaten on Sundays, hence the name, and it involves roasted meat, chicken, pork, lamb, beef, sometimes other things like turkey as well potatoes, vegetables, gravy, Yorkshire pudding.
turkey.zh: 传统上，这在周日食用，因此得名，它包括烤肉——鸡肉、猪肉、羊肉、牛肉，有时还有火鸡等其他东西——土豆、蔬菜、肉汁、约克郡布丁。
